_about: Founder memory seeded from what Aiden said in Claude conversations (Feb-Oct 2026). Review before loading. EXPLICIT = he said it. INFERRED = Claude's reading, not confirmed. Edit or delete anything that is wrong; corrections later should use `aios memory correct`.

company.name: Aiden McCaffery AI
company.vision: A quiet, highly profitable one-founder AI company that runs mostly on its own systems.
company.mission: Tell business owners what AI news means for them, then build the AI systems that save them time and money.
company.strategy: Personal brand under Aiden's name. Weekly AI-news content (YouTube first, clips to TikTok and Instagram) feeds a newsletter, which books calls, which become consulting clients. Niche can change; the engine stays.
company.business_model: Free content and newsletter -> free 20-minute AI quick-wins call -> paid AI audit -> paid automation builds -> monthly retainers.
customers: Small business owners, starting with local service businesses in San Diego

memories.subject: current_top_priority
memories.content: Start a business. School is handled in separate chats.

memories.subject: business_direction
memories.content: Build a YouTube, TikTok and Instagram presence around AI consulting that tells people the latest AI news; one YouTube channel to start; get clients, book calls, run a newsletter.

memories.subject: niche_flexibility
memories.content: The niche and the plan may change later; the system must be able to switch niche.

memories.subject: delegation_preference
memories.content: Wants the system to step in and make decisions on where to start, not just list options.

memories.subject: core_value
memories.content: Freedom and independence is the one thing he would optimize his life for.

memories.subject: core_drive
memories.content: Wants to prove something to himself.

memories.subject: definition_of_success
memories.content: A quiet empire that prints money while he lives freely.

memories.subject: risk_preference
memories.content: Calculated aggressive: big swings, but sized and planned so one loss cannot hurt badly.

memories.subject: wants_system_better_than_him_at
memories.content: Being more disciplined, a sharper and more educated thinker, and smoother socially.

memories.subject: writing_style
memories.content: Brief, simple, straightforward. Casual with friends, clean and direct for work. Never sound like AI, never over-explain, no fake enthusiasm.

memories.subject: education
memories.content: University of San Diego student; Finance and Real Estate majors, Economics minor.

memories.subject: built_trading_bot
memories.content: Built SEAKINGALPHA, an automated options trading bot. Proof he can build, not just talk.

memories.subject: career_fit_noted
memories.content: A career advisor meeting concluded quant trading / quant development fit him best.

memories.subject: no_background_jobs_yet
memories.content: Do not build scheduled tasks or background agents yet. Everything runs from manual commands, explicit actions, or events caused by an approved action.

memories.subject: founder_final_authority
memories.content: The founder remains the final authority. Spending, sending, publishing, deleting and system changes need his approval.

memories.subject: time_constraint_school
memories.content: Full-time student with exams and quizzes, so business work has to fit around coursework (roughly 6-8 hours a week was assumed in the first plan).
memories.source_ref: inferred from study-planning chats 2026-09/10; hours are Claude's assumption

memories.subject: prefers_action_over_planning
memories.content: Prefers getting started quickly over long planning.
memories.source_ref: inferred from how he phrases requests ('step in', 'decide for me'); weak evidence

decisions.question: What should the brand be named?
decisions.recommendation: Use his real name (Aiden McCaffery) so the brand survives a niche change.
decisions.reasoning: Consulting sells trust; a name brand carries across niches.

decisions.question: Face on camera or a faceless AI channel?
decisions.recommendation: Real face first; AI avatar only for shorts after week 9.
decisions.reasoning: Clients book people; YouTube has been demonetizing mass-produced faceless AI content.

decisions.question: Which platform first?
decisions.recommendation: YouTube long-form weekly, cut into clips for TikTok, Reels and Shorts.
decisions.reasoning: Search traffic compounds; one shoot feeds three platforms.

decisions.question: What is the first offer?
decisions.recommendation: Free 20-minute AI quick-wins call leading to a $497 AI audit.
decisions.reasoning: Low-friction yes first, money second; first 2-3 clients cheap or free for case studies.
